description:
ABOUT US:
AI NEEDS A NEW INFRASTRUCTURE LAYER. WE'RE BUILDING IT AT MODAL.

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp https://modal.com/blog/how-ramp-built-a-full-context-background-coding-agent-on-modal, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.


We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.


Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn https://github.com/mwaskom/seaborn,Luigi https://github.com/spotify/luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.




THE ROLE:

We’re looking for strong engineers with experience building software that developers love to work with. Our ideal candidate is someone with a demonstrated drive to build beautiful abstractions that enhance developer productivity.




WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON:

 - Improve the developer and agent experience of our SDK and CLI

 - Develop new primitives to meet demand for entirely new areas that arise as a result of the ongoing industry transformation




YOU MAY BE A FIT IF:

 - You have 5+ years of experience developing high-quality Python, JavaScript, or Go applications or libraries where the code is used or interacted with by other developers

 - You have a strong code-as-product sense that manifests as a focus on developer ergonomics and productivity

 - You understand async programming, concurrency management, and their pitfalls

 - You have a high level of customer empathy, good communication skills, and an openness to working directly with our users to help solve their problems

 - You’re able to participate in our on-call rotation and respond to production incidents

 - You’re able to work in person in our New York office




NICE-TO-HAVE:

 - Experience building developer tools or SDKs

 - Experience maintaining open-source software

 - Good understanding of agentic development workflows

 - Familiarity with modern data, ML, and AI tools and workflows
